target.why_305_307: 305 (tail-adjacent, ROUTE_AUDIT_R1 section 8 precedent) and 307 (already closed under RLR; no re-evaluation, no tuning) are quarantined for any new-route quantity. 306 and 308 are out of scope by instruction; 308 is under a separate live formal campaign elsewhere and is untouchable.

drift_band.rule: Inherited unchanged from overnight QUARANTINE_AMENDMENT_1 (stricter-only inheritance): no new operator quantity, candidate object, sup norm, remainder, cover quantity or consumer quantity is evaluated at any drift point or interval meeting the band or its mirror.
drift_band.theorem_M_transfer_rule: Inherited from overnight QUARANTINE_AMENDMENT_2 R2.1-R2.4: no validation-drift value of Lambda / E_a[tau] / P(tau>n) / supersolution values is juxtaposed with any 305-309 number, and no transfer into the band is stated as a number.

any target-equivalent numerical proxy: enclosure radius, rad_r, S-bar, H_k, M_k, magnitude, margin, pass/fail indicator, x-eff factor, critical constant or critical ratio for a quarantined cell under any new route

any new-route input quantity computed on a quarantined cell or inside the drift band (operator constants C_T, tau, Abar, D_lo, D1, D2, A0, A1, A2; sup norms; sigma3/sigma4; residual bounds; cover cells; order-3 objects; candidate payloads)

Monte Carlo or deterministic calculations whose output would reveal whether a proposed route closes 309
parameter tuning (degree, partition, truncation order, cover, tolerance, ladder, scale, route, consumer variant) against 309 or against any committed 309 figure
trying multiple routes on 309 and selecting the successful one
forbidden_executions: any historical campaign driver / consumer / exactly-once CLI (list in code/q309_guard.py FORBIDDEN_MODULES)
any exactly-once protocol step of any campaign: qualification, grant, marker arming, execution, seal, adjudication
creating, moving or deleting any ref under refs/p5y-*, refs/c1*, or any cell-308 namespace
any contact with the machine executing cell 308; any read of its uncommitted/transient state
allowed: reading committed text and JSON on origin refs, including historical 309 values, ONLY when necessary for provenance/history reconstruction; every such read that exposes a 309 numeric value is logged in ledger/EXPOSURE_LEDGER.jsonl
symbolic / exact-rational derivations, theorem statements and proofs

Any 309 number the coordinator itself sees is logged as a coordinator exposure.
